releases.name: NumeNume
releases.summary: Salvador is a fun and frolic archery game that tests your archery skills. It's just a great game to kick back on the couch and play.In this, the player is provided with a bow & arrow to cut the hangman's rope, without causing the victim a further hit.It gives you a chance to save the victim before they run out of breath.Try and gain the perfect score by saving the man as soon as possible, using least number of arrows.Are you willing to become a Salvador?  What are you waiting for then?FEATURES:* Sensitive and intuitive controls to rotate bow and arrow in all direction.* User friendly interface.* Excellent sound effects.* Various exciting levels.* Share your experience with your friends on facebookFollow us on Facebook : www.facebook.com/SalvadorTheSaviourCommunity

releases.name: Delivery Simulator
releases.summary:
Parcels don’t deliver themselves, and the city won’t make things easy for you. Take the wheel and face the intense daily grind of a delivery driver, navigating busy streets, tight shortcuts, and surprises at every corner. Collect orders, load the cargo, and plan the best route to arrive on time.

Unlock achievements by completing special objectives, beating the clock without crashing your car, and maintaining delivery streaks with no delays. More challenges mean more reasons to improve with every run!

The goal is simple: deliver as much as possible, earn rewards, buy a variety of insane vehicles, and upgrade your operation to become a true reference in the city. Because here, every second counts and every delivery makes a difference!

releases.name: Fishing Valley Remastered
releases.summary:
A fishing adventure where every cast takes you further.

One small boat. One simple rod. A whole valley waiting beyond the next haven.

Fishing Valley Remastered is a quest-driven fishing journey where every trip takes you a little farther. Travel from haven to haven, meet new characters, take on quests, and unlock new waters filled with new species and challenges to discover.

Every catch can move your journey forward. Sell your haul to upgrade your fishing gear and boat, opening the way to more distant waters and tougher catches — or keep your favorite fish and give them a home in your own aquarium.

Some species are easy to find. Others may take the right location, the right equipment, and a little more skill. Chase rare catches, complete your collection, follow the story, or simply take the boat out and enjoy the peaceful rhythm of fishing at your own pace.

• Travel from haven to haven and take on quests along the way
• Discover and collect a variety of fish species
• Upgrade your fishing gear and boat to reach new waters
• Keep your favorite catches and grow your own aquarium
• Follow the story or simply enjoy fishing at your own pace

releases.name: Counter Squad
releases.summary:
Every mission is a new test of your leadership.

Step into the world of Counter Squad, an intense tactical shooter where every operation demands skill, teamwork, and smart decision-making. Command an experienced special forces unit as you clear hostile territory, eliminate armed threats, protect civilians, and complete dangerous assignments in enemy-controlled locations. Success depends on careful planning and flawless execution.

Features:
• Lead an Elite Squad – Take charge of a professional tactical unit trained for high-risk combat operations.
• Plan Every Assault – Use strategy, positioning, and quick decisions to overcome heavily defended enemies.
• Action-Packed Combat – Experience exciting firefights with realistic weapons and responsive shooting mechanics.
• Challenging Operations – Complete a variety of mission objectives while unlocking new equipment and increasingly difficult assignments.
• Multiple Combat Locations – Fight through city blocks, industrial facilities, military compounds, and other hostile environments.
• Constant Battlefield Pressure – Adapt to unexpected enemy movements, reinforcements, and evolving combat situations.

Every mission puts your leadership to the test. Stay focused, protect your team, and complete every objective to prove that Counter Squad is ready for any challenge.

releases.name: Brand Nacht
releases.summary: Play as a bored and increasingly frustrated firefighter left behind by his crew in this short walking simulator. Explore the detailed rooms of an empty fire station and experience the restless hours in between call outs.

releases.name: Five Nights with Maids
releases.summary: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

releases.name: SOLEMNFABLE
releases.summary: Fight and forgive in this QTE based RPG, and travel the Earth and stars with those who matter most. SOLEMNFABLE - A journey of acceptance.

releases.name: Hollenburg, Hell Castle
releases.summary: "Höllenburg: Hell Castle" is an arcade game with video adventure elements, where you must explore a dark and satanic castle to defeat the generals of evil. Collect items, gain experience points, and level up while uncovering hidden secrets.

releases.name: Inkpress
releases.summary: A relaxing puzzle game about pressing blocks. No rush, just satisfying solutions.

releases.name: Its Flammin Bingo
releases.summary: Its Flammin Bingo is a rougelike strategy game about playing bingo. Buy and use items in the shop to weigh the odds in your favor. Earn enough points to complete each round and earn coins. Gain bingo after bingo to thrive.

releases.name: A Dungeon Is You
releases.summary:
Oh no, you got hit by a truck and died. Fortunately you have been reincarnated as a dungeon core! All you know is what's inside your dungeon domain.

All you want is to grow stronger and expand your dungeon.

A Dungeon Is You is a modern incremental management game.

releases.name: Fire and Water: Spirits of the Forest
releases.summary: Embark on this two-player adventure in a colorful world to forge a strong bond with your friend, partner, or family. Overcome challenging puzzles. Unleash your unique playstyle using the diverse abilities of Fire, Water, and 5 other forest spirits.

releases.name: VHS World '89
releases.summary: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

releases.name: Stream Train
releases.summary: Stream Train is a co-op adventure where up to 6 players livestream their trip through the Uncanny Valley. Grow your audience by taunting cryptid creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Can you make it through the valley alive?

releases.name: Break Order
releases.summary: Which Country is the new game with a new concept! You must find one country with 4 pictures that it show at the screen! You must find the name of many country to finish the game. We add new country after each update. Do you search a real challenge ? Do you want the game to play in subway, for the waiting room or just before to sleep ? This game is for you. Good Game!

releases.name: I Was Summoned to Another World, but All I Do Is Organize a Run-Down Village
releases.summary: The Hero saved the world. Then he smashed every jar in your village looking for loose change. You got the class Neighbour and the skill Organizer. Put 4,584 things back where they belong — you'll have to learn whose style they are — before he comes through the door again.

releases.name: Cozy Cat Shop
releases.summary:
※本作は日本語に対応しておりません。

街で一番居心地の良い「猫ショップ」を経営してみたいと思ったことはありませんか？

「Cozy Cat Shop（コージー・キャット・ショップ）」へようこそ！ここは、愛らしい猫たち、幸せなお客様、そして無限の可能性が出会う場所です。夢のお店を作り上げ、魅力あふれる様々な猫種と出会い、お客様が運命の猫と巡り合えるような、温かみのある空間を創り出しましょう。

最初は小さなお店からスタートし、賑やかな「猫の楽園」へと成長させていきましょう。スペースを広げ、インテリアを自分好みにカスタマイズし、ビジネスを拡大しながら、たくさんの愛らしい猫たちに囲まれる素敵な毎日を過ごしてください！

主な特徴：
- 多彩な猫種との出会い
- 居心地の良い猫ショップの経営・拡大
- お店のカスタマイズ
- ビジネスの成長

たくさんの愛らしい猫たちと出会いましょう！

releases.name: Crab Evolution Roguelite
releases.summary:
Can you build the perfect mutant and survive every dangerous stage?

Enter a dangerous pixel-art world where survival depends on how far you are willing to transform. Take control of a strange creature and fight through relentless waves of enemies in a fast-paced 2D roguelite where every run brings new dangers, new choices, and new opportunities to evolve.

Collect experience, discover powerful mutations, and reshape your creature with every decision you make. Combine passive effects, active abilities, and physical mutations to create unique builds that can completely change the way you fight and survive. Experiment with different combinations, adapt to unexpected challenges, and find the mutations that turn your creature into an unstoppable force.

Key Features:
• Powerful Mutations: Combine 60+ passive, 30+ active, and 30+ physical mutations to create unique builds.
• Transform Your Creature: Physical mutations change your character's appearance and shape the way you play.
• Fast-Paced Roguelite Action: Fight through intense enemy waves in challenging 2D survival runs.
• 4 Unique Maps: Explore dangerous pixel-art environments filled with different enemies and challenging encounters.
• Every Run Is Different: Adapt to random mutation choices and experiment with new builds every run.

releases.name: Bathyscaphe (DARTKIS)
releases.summary: Dive to the bottom of the Mariana Trench, 11,034 metres down. Short dives, a searchlight against the dark, rare samples, strange creatures and a small yellow bathyscaphe that goes a little deeper after every upgrade. What waits at the bottom? You will find out at the end.

releases.name: Mendicant Sea
releases.summary: If you like playing word games - we have something for you!Word Search is a classic puzzle game. The objective is to find and mark all the words hidden on a board within the time limit.Word Search has for you:- thousands of carefully selected english words- only nouns- three difficulty levels- unlimited high quality puzzles - it's different every time you play thanks to our unique words choosing and hiding algorithm- stats area (Lets you track your records)- Game Center integration (Leaderboards and almost 100 Achievements)- great gameplay- cool sound effects and animations- universal app - buy one and get an app for iphone, ipod touch and ipadWord Search is fun and educational at the same time.Can you find all the words?Play now and try!

releases.name: Coin and Banner
releases.summary: Start with a purse and nobody at your back. Hire men one at a time, learn their names, and lead them in side-view battles of hundreds. Train soldiers and fire-callers, storm walls, and take towns. Serve a lord or rise to a crown in a medieval sandbox RPG. The dead stay dead.

releases.name: Tiny Cities
releases.summary: Settle an island and grow it into a busy town in this relaxed city builder. Create roads, farms, and watch citizens carry every good on foot. Research new technology, upgrade shelters for more citizens, and keep every home supplied.

releases.name: DEADLUCK V
releases.summary: DEADLUCK V is a roguelike dice game with the devil. Carve your dice one face at a time, roll hands and hit combos, and try to survive against a cheating house.

releases.name: Hallow
releases.summary: Medieval Wars is a strategy simulation game that is based on actual history from the ancient times to the renaissance. Develop new technologies, advance to new ages, and attack and capture nations around you.If your flag is waved in both East and West, you are victorious!
